NAME
sys_reload_tls() - Reload the TLS certificate and key for a given port.

SYNOPSIS
void sys_reload_tls ( int port_index );

DESCRIPTION
Reload the TLS certificate and key for the port index specified in the configuration file.

For example, if external_port_1_tls is defined in the configuration, call sys_reload_tls(1) to reload it. This allows certificate and key updates without restarting the server.

Notes:
- Overwrite the previous certificate/key files on disk before calling this function.
- Reloading TLS for a websocket port is not currently supported.
- Added on May 30, 2023 in branch 3bca73a.
